## Mentoring

**Independent Study and Special Projects**

+ [Priya Kruthi Gavini](https://www.linkedin.com/in/priya-kruthi-gavini-591246213/),  BS Industrial Engineering, Independent Study, University of Massachusetts Amherst (Advisor: Dr. Erin Baker). Priya Kruthi works in the the project Measuring performance and experience for learning curve. She focus in three main topic during the independent study: (1) Build learning curve projection models under different assumption , (2) Review the literature given this understanding of learning curves, and in the question (3) What should we use as unit of experience in wastewater treatment facilities (for water recycled)? \| ***Spring 2023***
